mechanism.name: literal_carrier_preserving_line_elision_v22_k1
mechanism.window_is_the_only_variable: K is the only parameter of this mechanism; it was pre-registered per K in integrations/openai_agents/V22_WINDOW_DOSE_PLAN_20261010.json and may not be changed after any saving number is seen
mechanism.rule: the frozen v12 exact duplicate rule runs first; the v5 lineage evidence-safe selective retention runs on the deduplicated list; the literal-carrier line elision then keeps verbatim every line that carries a registered literal or constraint phrase together with one line before and after it (K=1), elides every other line and replaces each maximal omitted run with one interval note, and keeps the most recent tool group verbatim; any literal loss, any non-reduction or any exception sends the payload this stage received, verbatim

task_set_note: the three v18 sealed candidates registered in integrations/openai_agents/V18_SOURCE_REGISTRATION_20261010.json; they are spent once this batch runs and are never replaced by another id

view_shape.note: the registry is pointed at this artifact in its sealed mode, so the registered task table of this batch is exactly the three tasks above: the stage-1 development task the registry appends in development mode is not part of this matrix

autoreload_template_changed.consequence: the defect view is the last read, so the mechanism keeps that tool group verbatim on every later model input; its literals are never at risk and no saving may be attributed to it
autoreload_template_changed.reported_as: an explanatory fact of the task shape, disclosed before the batch and not claimed as a merit of the mechanism

sitemap_callable_lastmod.consequence: the defect view is the first read, so it is elidable content on later model inputs under the literal invariant
sitemap_callable_lastmod.reported_as: an explanatory fact of the task shape, disclosed before the batch and not claimed as a merit of the mechanism

query_utils_unregister_lookup.consequence: the defect view is the first read, so it is elidable content on later model inputs under the literal invariant
query_utils_unregister_lookup.reported_as: an explanatory fact of the task shape, disclosed before the batch and not claimed as a merit of the mechanism

matrix.repeats_rationale: at three repeats one sample is about 11 to 13 percent of a task's strict track and therefore decides it on its own; five repeats bring the granularity to about 7 percent, which is the repeat count the v16 sealed confirmation batch used

host_configuration.structured_final_answer: JSON issue/cause/fix/facts asked for in the prompt, identical for every arm, rendered by the frozen renderer, which is the final-answer path and the only validator; a rejected proposal is closed to an empty answer

trigger_gate.policy: the plugin arm's BudgetTriggeredFilter is installed with soft_limit_tokens=0, which the frozen class floors to 1 (trigger_gate_soft_limit_tokens therefore reports 1), so its condition last_estimated_tokens <= soft_limit_tokens is false for every non-empty payload and the gate fires on every model input after the first; the gate stays in place, keeps measuring each payload and keeps publishing its counters. The setting is inherited from v20 unchanged, so this round measures the window and does not re-measure the gate. Trigger policy stays symmetric_budget so the wrapper is not removed from the plugin arm.

host_configuration.module_set_note: the module set is the v22 dose round's set with the registry this round resolves tasks through, the modules the frozen runner imports, the module that wrote the registration and this runner added; it is a superset, and no module was removed
host_configuration.revision_aware_fail_closed: every module in the path must have a SHA256 recorded here and in this configuration's revision ledger; a module whose digest is absent or differs fails the gate, and the paid path refuses to start until the change is registered in a new revision

budget_arithmetic.derivation: READ_CALLS=3 => MAX_TURNS = 3+2 = 5 => worst case 6 per sample => 45x6 + 15x2 = 300 => 1.3x => 390

acceptance_line.line: per task, the plugin arm's strict track is at least the baseline's (the four conditions judged on the rendered line) AND the paired complete provider-token saving is positive for a majority of pairs AND the batch mean is positive. The verdict is decided on every pair of the frozen matrix; the symmetric matched-prefix reading, the byte reading, the strict-track and semantic-accuracy endpoints per arm and the per-arm call distribution are reported beside it and never substitute for it. Failures, cap hits, retries and summary requests are all charged to their arm.
acceptance_line.decided_on: every pair of the frozen matrix
acceptance_line.strict_track: the four conditions judged on the rendered line: required facts present, frozen regex full match, single line with the contract prefix, at most 160 characters
acceptance_line.paired_statistic: paired complete provider-token totals per (task, repeat) pair, with retries and summary tokens charged to the arm they belong to
acceptance_line.bounds_are_not_relaxed: at most 160 characters remains an acceptance condition

primary_criterion.name: as-paired complete provider tokens
primary_criterion.definition: for every (task, repeat) pair: (baseline total tokens - plugin total tokens) / baseline total tokens, where a sample's total is its complete provider input tokens plus its complete provider output tokens, with retries and summary requests charged to the arm they belong to
primary_criterion.verdict: per task: the plugin arm's strict track is at least the baseline's; across the batch: a majority of pairs positive and the mean positive
primary_criterion.never_merged_with: the v16 sealed confirmation batch's 12.54 percent is reported beside this batch's number and the two are never merged and never pooled, because the host configuration and the mechanism differ

co_reported.name: symmetric matched prefix, provider tokens
co_reported.definition: for each pair, take the first k model calls of EACH arm, where k = min(baseline calls, plugin calls), and compare the summed complete provider input tokens of those two prefixes; the truncation must be symmetric, so an arm's own retry cannot hide inside its own sum

co_reported.name: matched prefix, context bytes
co_reported.definition: the same symmetric prefix over the per-boundary context bytes the recorder wrote for each model input

co_reported.name: strict track and semantic accuracy per arm
co_reported.definition: rate per arm, per task and pooled

co_reported.name: mechanism counters and guard fallbacks
co_reported.definition: v21_* per task and per sample

co_reported.name: determinism of the mechanism's byte saving per repeat
co_reported.definition: the v21 counters of the three repeats of each task side by side

co_reported.name: requests, cap and cache
co_reported.definition: api_request_attempts against the cap, and the provider cache split

manifest_contract.writer: the frozen v17 finalise_pilot_manifest, wrapped by this runner

not_evidence_yet: both citation flags stay false until the independent audit passes; the three tasks of this batch took no part in building the host configuration, but the configuration itself - and the window K - was calibrated on other tasks, so this batch confirms the configuration and the mechanism on an untouched task set rather than establishing a general result
tool_output_disclosure: the plugin arm's read output may be elided: lines that carry no registered literal are removed and every maximal omitted run is replaced by exactly one explicit interval note of the form [elided n lines first-last], so the omission is declared and the omitted range is recoverable by re-issuing the read. Every registered literal keeps at least as many verbatim occurrences as it had before the elision; the reader tool's own description is identical in all three arms, because the frozen registry builds it once per task and v21 does not rewrite it for any arm, so 'returns those numbered lines verbatim' holds for every line that is kept. No silent omission occurs: nothing is removed without an interval note.

re_read_visibility.rule: per arm: tool_calls and model_calls are reported for every sample, so a re-read induced by an elision appears as extra tool calls and is billed

forbidden_wording: the plugin saves about 12.5 percent of context
report_requirements: the primary criterion: per-task and pooled paired saving in complete provider tokens, with dispersion and the count of positive pairs
the symmetric matched-prefix reading in provider tokens and in context bytes
the strict track and the semantic accuracy per arm, per task and pooled
per-arm tool_calls and model_calls, and which arm retried in each pair
the mechanism counters per task and per repeat, including the guard fallbacks
the determinism of the mechanism's byte saving across the repeats of each task
actual requests against the cap, dollar cost and the cache split, with the off-peak flag
the acceptance verdict recomputed independently by the audit
wording: under this host configuration; the v16 sealed batch's number is reported beside this one and never merged with it
stop_conditions: batch mean at or below zero -> stop and report
any task whose plugin strict track or semantic accuracy is below its baseline -> stop and report, do not add samples and do not change the reading
any render failure, truncation or dropped field -> stop and report
request cap reached -> stop, keep the partial directory, continue under a new id; --resume may never be used to bypass the budget
any request failure -> stop and report
audit errors non-empty -> the batch may not be cited as an effective saving
never_rejudge: v12 to v15, the v16 sealed confirmation batch and its audit, the v17 and v19 to v21 rounds and every v22 group are untouched and unrejudged
source_of_record_note: the frozen finaliser re-verifies every entry of this map before it writes the batch manifest, and the paid path re-verifies it before the first request
